# Specification

Written first, before the noise budget and before any component value was
chosen. Every target below is a requirement; the noise budget
([hardware/docs/noise_budget.md](../hardware/docs/noise_budget.md)) shows how
the design is meant to meet it and the validation report
([validation_report.md](validation_report.md)) shows what the simulated
board achieves.

## What the channel is for

One differential channel that digitises a slowly varying or low frequency
voltage to about 20 effective bits: cell voltages and shunt currents in a
battery pack, a strain or pressure bridge, or surface EMG. The two sibling
projects that would consume it set the numbers: battery sensing needs DC
accuracy across a wide span at gain 1 and the sEMG front end needs the 20 to
450 Hz band with sub microvolt noise at high gain.

## Signal path

| Item | Value | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Input | Differential, bipolar | Bridges and sEMG electrodes are differential |
| Source impedance, budget case | 175 ohm per leg | A 350 ohm full bridge; battery taps and shunts are lower |
| Gains | 1, 8, 32, 128 | Switched in the analogue front end |
| Reference | 2.5 V, ratiometric | Full scale is +/-Vref / G |
| Converter | 24-bit sigma-delta, 1-bit order 4 loop | |
| Modulator clock | 614.4 kHz | |
| Oversampling ratio | 256 (nominal; 32 to 65,504 selectable) | |
| Output data rate | 2400 SPS (nominal) | |
| Decimation filter | sinc4 | Nulls at every multiple of the output rate |
| Bandwidth | DC to 500 Hz | Covers the sEMG band |
| Droop at 500 Hz | -2.52 dB (limit 3 dB) | -3 dB at 546 Hz |
| Droop at 450 Hz | -2.03 dB | Top of the sEMG band |
| Alias rejection at f_mod - 500 Hz | at least 60 dB | The digital filter gives none there |

## Ranges and noise targets

Noise is input referred, at 2400 SPS, integrated over the whole decimator
response (equivalent noise bandwidth 575.2 Hz).

| Gain | Full scale | LSB | Noise target |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | +/-2500 mV | 298.023 nV | 0.75 uV rms |
| 8 | +/-312.5 mV | 37.253 nV | 0.40 uV rms |
| 32 | +/-78.125 mV | 9.313 nV | 0.32 uV rms |
| 128 | +/-19.53125 mV | 2.328 nV | 0.30 uV rms |

## Accuracy targets

| Item | Target |
|---|---|
| SNR, gain 1, -1 dBFS sine | at least 120 dB |
| THD, gain 1, -1 dBFS sine | at most -110 dB |
| ENOB, (SINAD - 1.76) / 6.02, gain 1, -1 dBFS | at least 19 bits |
| INL, best fit line | at most 5 ppm of FSR |
| Error after two point calibration, any gain, anywhere in range | within +/-10 ppm of FSR |

The THD target follows from the INL target (a 5 ppm third order bow puts the
third harmonic near -110 dB) and the ENOB target follows from SNR and THD
together. They were set as a group so that one cannot be met only by
breaking another.

## Out of scope for this revision

Temperature drift, common mode rejection, EMC immunity, multiple channels
and isolation. Each is a real requirement for a product and none can be
checked without hardware or a far more detailed model; see STATUS.md.
